items.title: 550 Wanamaker Coupeville WA 98239
items.description: Rare and extraordinary multigenerational compound on 11+ acres in the heart of Central Whidbey Island — where two beautifully appointed residences, endless outdoor amenities, and a lifetime of possibilities come together in one truly remarkable package. Two completely separate residences, each with their own private entrance, are thoughtfully connected by an enchanting enclosed garden and gazebo area complete with an outdoor kitchen — the perfect setting for al fresco entertaining and the ideal balance of togetherness & independence. The newly updated 1958 home honors its character with modern comfort, while the stunning 2022 residence showcases live edge Douglas Fir finishes and exterior wood milled directly from the property itself — a level of craftsmanship and authenticity that simply cannot be replicated. Above the barn, a light-filled artist studio, a fenced garden, chicken coop, fruit trees, & a versatile barn with endless possibilities complete a property that feels like its own private world. Partial water views & over 11 acres of lush land deliver the space, privacy, & freedom that define Whidbey Island living at its finest. Whether you envision a multigenerational retreat, working hobby farm, artist's haven, or a private sanctuary — this home delivers on every front. Includes 2 buildable lots in the Crockett Lake community. Gems like this simply do not come around often. Also see listing #2554897 which does NOT include the 2 additional building lots.
